findings.evidence: The IP address from which you access our Websites; The name of the domain from which you access the Internet (for example, gmail.com, if you are connecting from a Google account); The type of browser and operating system used to access our Websites; The date and time you access our sites; The pages, files, documents and links that you visit
Some Smithsonian Websites use third-party vendors, such as Google Analytics, to place cookies and analyze the information collected by cookies
The data provided by this service (such as age, gender, and interests) is used to better understand visitors to these Websites and customize our Websites to our users' interest.
The data is retained for as long as necessary to support the mission of the Smithsonian Websites.
